name: Millet Curd Rice
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ½ cup barnyard or little millet, rinsed
¾ cup plain low-fat yogurt, whisked
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
¼ cucumber, diced, and 2 tbsp pomegranate seeds
steps: Cook the millet in 1½ cups water until very soft, about 15 minutes. Mash lightly and cool completely.
Mix with the yogurt, milk and salt to a creamy consistency.
Heat the oil, crackle the mustard, and fry the urad dal until golden. Add chilli, ginger and curry leaves.
Top with cucumber, pomegranate and coriander.
note: Always cool the millet fully before adding yogurt so it does not split.
